title: 【RPG Design Guides】Battle Balance ①-2: Archetypes of Ally Ability Settings

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】戦闘バランス①-2 味方の能力設定の類型
blocks.translation: 【RPG Design Guides】Battle Balance ①-2: Archetypes of Ally Ability Settings

blocks.source: ダンジョンＲＰＧを作成するにあたって、味方の能力設定の類型例を作成してみたので記述してみる。
blocks.translation: In preparation for creating a dungeon RPG, I put together some examples of archetypal ability setups for allies, so I will describe them here.

blocks.source: 多くのＲＰＧでは「キャラクターＡはキャラクターＢに比較して劣るため、役に立たない」というような状況が生まれている。そうならないために、各キャラクターに明確な長所と短所を設定したい。
blocks.translation: In many RPGs, situations arise where “Character A is inferior to Character B and therefore useless.” To prevent this, I want to give each character clear strengths and weaknesses.

blocks.source: 類形例
blocks.translation: Archetype Examples

blocks.source: 重戦士
blocks.translation: Heavy Warrior

blocks.source: 攻撃力・ＨＰ・守備力が高く、素早さが低い。パーティのダメージ源としての役割と壁としての役割を併せ持つ。守備力は高いが、魔法攻撃には弱いなどの特徴を持つことも。
blocks.translation: High attack power, HP, and defense, but low agility. This character serves both as the party’s source of damage and its tank. They may also have traits such as high defense but low resistance to magic attacks.

blocks.source: 上記の例では、ＤＱシリーズの戦士系キャラやファイアーエムブレムのアーマーナイトが典型例である。また、ワイルドアームズ４のラクウェルは攻撃力が極めて高いが、ＨＰも素早さも低めという味付けがしてあって面白い。
blocks.translation: Typical examples include warrior-type characters from the Dragon Quest series and Armor Knights from Fire Emblem. Raquel from Wild Arms 4 is also interestingly designed with extremely high attack power but relatively low HP and agility.

blocks.source: 軽戦士
blocks.translation: Light Warrior

blocks.source: 攻撃力・素早さが高いが、ＨＰは重戦士より低い。
blocks.translation: High attack power and agility, but lower HP than a heavy warrior.

blocks.source: ＡＴＢ、ＣＴＢなど素早さが多いほど行動回数が増えるシステムだと、重戦士よりもダメージ源としては優秀となることも。武闘家・忍者などがこれに該当する。
blocks.translation: In systems such as ATB and CTB, where higher agility means more actions, this character can sometimes be a better source of damage than a heavy warrior. Martial artists and ninjas fall into this category.

blocks.source: 魔道士
blocks.translation: Mage

blocks.source: ＭＰを消費しての攻撃魔法が得意だが、打たれ弱い。派手な魔法で敵を倒す姿はＲＰＧの華とも言える。
blocks.translation: Skilled at offensive magic that consumes MP, but physically frail. Defeating enemies with flashy magic can be considered one of the hallmarks of an RPG.

blocks.source: 攻撃役としての役割は戦士と重なるため、差別化を考えよう。
blocks.translation: Since this role overlaps with that of a warrior as an attacker, think about how to differentiate them.

blocks.source: まず、戦士は多くのＲＰＧにおいて、ＭＰを消費せずとも戦える上に、壁役としてのタフさを持つことが多い。対して、魔法使いはＭＰを消費しなければ戦えない上に、打たれ弱いという弱点がある。
blocks.translation: First, in many RPGs, warriors can fight without consuming MP and are often tough enough to serve as tanks. Mages, on the other hand, cannot fight without consuming MP and have the weakness of being physically frail.

blocks.source: そのため、攻撃性能が同程度ならば、魔道士は戦士に劣ることになる。
blocks.translation: Therefore, if their offensive capabilities are comparable, the mage will be inferior to the warrior.

blocks.source: そこで、以下のような方法を１つあるいは複数とればよい。
blocks.translation: In that case, use one or more of the following approaches.

blocks.source: 戦士の物理攻撃よりも、魔法攻撃の威力をあげる。
blocks.translation: Make magic attacks more powerful than the warrior’s physical attacks.

blocks.source: 攻撃魔法に加えて、補助魔法を持たせる。
blocks.translation: Give the mage support magic in addition to offensive magic.

blocks.source: 物理攻撃が効きにくい敵を作る。
blocks.translation: Create enemies that are resistant to physical attacks.

blocks.source: 全体攻撃などの複数攻撃を魔法の特権とする。
blocks.translation: Make multi-target attacks such as all-enemy attacks a privilege of magic.

blocks.source: 属性攻撃などの弱点攻撃を魔法の特権とする。
blocks.translation: Make exploiting weaknesses, such as elemental attacks, a privilege of magic.

blocks.source: こういう調整は基本中の基本であるが、ＲＰＧの代表格たるＤＱシリーズですら、これが十分にできているとは言いがたい。特にＤＱ６，７では、特技が強すぎて攻撃魔法の役目を奪ってしまっている。攻撃魔法をこよなく愛する僕としては悲しい。
blocks.translation: This kind of adjustment is fundamental, but even the Dragon Quest series, a representative example of the RPG genre, can hardly be said to handle it sufficiently. In particular, in Dragon Quest VI and VII, Techs are so powerful that they take over the role of offensive magic. As someone who dearly loves offensive magic, I find that sad.

blocks.source: なお、サガ１，２やファイアーエムブレム、ポケモンなどのように、物理攻撃と魔法攻撃を対等の扱いにしてしまうのも手である。
blocks.translation: Another approach is to treat physical and magic attacks equally, as in SaGa 1 and 2, Fire Emblem, and Pokémon.

blocks.source: これらの作品では物理でも魔法でも同等にポイントを消費するため、物理と魔法の違いは依存するステータスでしかなくなるわけである。
blocks.translation: In these works, physical and magic attacks consume an equal number of points, so the only difference between them is the stat they depend on.

blocks.source: 神官
blocks.translation: Cleric

blocks.source: 東洋風（？）に言えば僧侶。回復魔法によって、味方のＨＰを回復したり状態異常を治すのが主な役目。
blocks.translation: In Eastern-style terms (?), this would be a monk. Their primary role is to restore allies’ HP and cure status ailments with healing magic.

blocks.source: このタイプのキャラクターは性能次第でゲームバランスが激変する。特に全体回復や蘇生を簡単に使えるようにすると、大味なバランスになってしまうので注意。
blocks.translation: Depending on this character’s capabilities, the game balance can change dramatically. Be careful, especially if you make party-wide healing or revival easy to use, as the balance can become overly simplistic.

blocks.source: ホーリーが使えるＦＦの白魔道士の様に攻撃魔法も使える場合があるが、強すぎて魔道士の役目を奪わないようにも注意。
blocks.translation: They may sometimes be able to use offensive magic as well, like the White Mage in Final Fantasy who can cast Holy, but be careful not to make them so powerful that they take over the mage’s role.

blocks.source: 回復役がいないと、難易度が大きく上がってしまうため、事実上加入が必須となる作品が多い。
blocks.translation: Without a healer, the difficulty rises considerably, so many games effectively require one to join the party.

blocks.source: 別にそれでもいいのだが、僕としては選択肢が狭くてつまらないので、下の聖戦士や賢者・万能などのタイプのキャラクターを入れることで、神官なしでも何とかなるように調整している。
blocks.translation: There is nothing wrong with that, but I find the limited choice boring, so I adjust the game by including characters such as the paladin, sage, or all-rounder types below, making it possible to manage without a cleric.

blocks.source: 盗賊
blocks.translation: Thief

blocks.source: 素早さが高いが、他の能力は平均的。
blocks.translation: High agility, but average in other abilities.

blocks.source: 軽戦士に類似しているが、補助など攻撃以外の役目を持っているのが特徴。
blocks.translation: Similar to a light warrior, but characterized by having roles other than attacking, such as providing support.

blocks.source: ＤＱなどのターン制ＲＰＧならば、素早さが高いだけではさほどのメリットにならないので、他の長所も考えよう。
blocks.translation: In turn-based RPGs such as Dragon Quest, high agility alone is not much of an advantage, so think of other strengths as well.

blocks.source: ＣＴＢならば補助に攻撃に、と優秀に活動できる。
blocks.translation: In a CTB system, they can perform well in both support and offense.

blocks.source: 詩人
blocks.translation: Bard

blocks.source: 詩人と書いただけでイメージが伝わるかどうか怪しいが、要するにここで書きたいのは補助・異常などサポート系の魔法・特技の使い手のことである。
blocks.translation: It is questionable whether writing “bard” conveys the intended image, but in short, this refers to a user of support-oriented magic and Techs, such as buffs and status ailments.

blocks.source: 踊子などもこれに同じ。ＦＦの時魔道士の様な作品独自の職業である場合も。
blocks.translation: Dancers and similar classes also fit this category. In some works, this may be a unique class from that title, such as Final Fantasy’s Time Mage.

blocks.source: 補助という点では盗賊に似ているが、攻撃は物理・魔法共に苦手。主に技能は味方にかける補助と敵にかける状態異常の２種類に分かれる。
blocks.translation: They resemble thieves in terms of support, but are poor at both physical and magical offense. Their abilities mainly fall into two categories: support effects applied to allies and status ailments inflicted on enemies.

blocks.source: もっとも、サポート系の技能は魔道士・神官・盗賊・魔法戦士などに分散させることも多いので、そうなるとこのタイプは存在自体が不要な場合も。
blocks.translation: However, support abilities are often distributed among mages, clerics, thieves, and magic warriors, so in that case this type may not need to exist at all.

blocks.source: 魔法戦士
blocks.translation: Magic Warrior

blocks.source: 物理攻撃と魔法攻撃の両方が得意。
blocks.translation: Skilled at both physical and magical attacks.

blocks.source: 硬い敵には魔法。柔らかい敵には物理。というように敵に合わせた攻撃ができる。
blocks.translation: They can adapt their attacks to the enemy: magic against tough enemies and physical attacks against soft enemies.

blocks.source: とはいえ、物理攻撃は戦士未満、魔法攻撃は魔道士未満であるため、特徴がない相手には単なる器用貧乏になりかねない。
blocks.translation: Even so, their physical attacks are weaker than a warrior’s and their magic attacks are weaker than a mage’s, so against an opponent without any distinctive traits, they may end up being merely a jack of all trades and master of none.

blocks.source: こういった職業の調整こそ、制作者の腕の見せ所である。
blocks.translation: Balancing classes like these is precisely where a creator can show their skill.

blocks.source: 例えば、下記のような役割を持たせるだけでも、上記２職業の単純劣化にはならない。
blocks.translation: For example, simply giving them roles like those below prevents them from being mere inferior versions of the two classes above.

blocks.source: ＨＰの高い魔道士。
blocks.translation: A mage with high HP.

blocks.source: 補助・異常や全体攻撃ができる戦士。
blocks.translation: A warrior capable of support, status ailments, and all-enemy attacks.

blocks.source: 突出した能力がない分、素早さなど他の能力値は高めにしておくのも良い手だ。
blocks.translation: Since they lack any outstanding ability, it is also a good idea to make other stats, such as agility, somewhat higher.

blocks.source: 聖戦士
blocks.translation: Paladin

blocks.source: 物理攻撃と回復魔法の両方が得意。回復魔法を使う機会はどのＲＰＧでも非常に多いので、魔法戦士よりも調整は容易。序盤から回復が使えると安定するので、主人公のタイプとしても有望。
blocks.translation: Proficient in both physical attacks and healing magic. Since there are many opportunities to use healing magic in any RPG, this type is easier to balance than a battlemage. Being able to heal from the beginning provides stability, making this a promising type for the protagonist as well.

blocks.source: 賢者
blocks.translation: Sage

blocks.source: 攻撃・回復双方の魔法を行使できる。当然、魔道士や神官との差別化が鍵となる。
blocks.translation: Can use both offensive and healing magic. Naturally, the key is differentiating this type from mages and priests.

blocks.source: 調整法としては……
blocks.translation: Possible approaches to balancing it include...

blocks.source: 攻撃・回復の双方の性能を魔道士・神官より下にする。
blocks.translation: Make both its offensive and healing capabilities inferior to those of mages and priests.

blocks.source: ＨＰや素早さなど他のパラメータをより低くする。
blocks.translation: Lower other parameters, such as HP and Agility.

blocks.source: などが挙げられる。
blocks.translation: These are some possible approaches.

blocks.source: 万能
blocks.translation: All-Rounder

blocks.source: 全ての能力が平均的。物理攻撃、攻撃魔法、回復魔法いずれも可能。
blocks.translation: Average in every ability. Capable of physical attacks, offensive magic, and healing magic.

blocks.source: 主人公ならば、全ての能力が高水準な勇者タイプにしてしまって問題ない。難しいのはそれ以外の場合だ。器用貧乏と万能の境目を見極める必要がある。ゲームシステムによりけりなので、実際のテストプレイで確かめよう。
blocks.translation: For a protagonist, it is perfectly fine to make them a Luminary type with all abilities at a high level. The difficult part is when this is not the case. You need to determine where to draw the line between a jack of all trades and an all-rounder. It depends on the game system, so check through actual playtesting.

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: 上記の区分は大雑把な分類であり、さらに詳細な味付けをすることもできる。例えば、重戦士にしても、攻撃力を高くしてダメージ源としての役割を強調するか、ＨＰや守備力を高めて壁としての役割を強調するかなど、個性を出すことができる。
blocks.translation: The categories above are rough classifications, and you can add more detailed nuances. For example, even with a heavy warrior, you can give it individuality by emphasizing its role as a source of damage through high Attack, or its role as a shield by increasing its HP and Defense.

blocks.source: あえて、上記にない特徴を持ったタイプのキャラクター・職業を考えてみても良い。
blocks.translation: You could also try coming up with a character or class type with traits not listed above.

blocks.source: イメージしづらいが「ＨＰが高い」「攻撃魔法が得意」「素早さが低い」などの組み合わせでも、バランスは取れる。サガシリーズの人外キャラクターなどが近いだろうか。
blocks.translation: Although it may be difficult to picture, combinations such as “high HP,” “proficient in offensive magic,” and “low Agility” can also be balanced. Non-human characters from the SaGa series may be similar examples.

blocks.source: また、前の記事でも書いたが、ＦＦの青魔道士の様に、魔法・特技の習得方法でも個性を出すことができるし、竜騎士のジャンプの様に特徴的な技を職業の個性とすることもできる。
blocks.translation: As I wrote in the previous article, characters can also be given individuality through how they learn magic and Techs, as with the Blue Mage in FF, or by making a distinctive technique, such as the Dragoon’s Jump, a defining trait of the class.

Since there are many opportunities to use healing magic in any RPG, this type is easier to balance than a battlemage. Being able to heal from the beginning provides stability, making this a promising type for the protagonist as well.
